title: Prompt composition is content-addressable
statement: composePrompt({task_id, components, timestamp}) MUST produce a PromptComposition whose id is `PC-` followed by the first 16 hex chars of stack_sha256, where stack_sha256 is sha256 over the canonical sequence `${layer}|${name}|${body_sha256}` joined by '\n' for each component in order. Same components in the same order MUST yield the same id and stack_sha256, regardless of timestamp.
rationale: Article 37 governs the prompt stack as the auditable input to every LLM-backed loop step. Content-addressed IDs let two runs that share inputs share evidence; drift in any component surfaces in the top-level stack_sha256. The frozen_against field anchors governed loops to a specific prompt fingerprint.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
